manifest.title_fil: Iugnay ang gawain ng BHW at BHERT
objectives_fil: Sa fictional na kaso, sa mock team change, tukuyin ang dapat kumpirmahin at magbigay ng maikling handover nang walang personal na detalye.
objectives_en: In a fictional case, in a mock team change, identify what to confirm and give a short handover without personal details.

sections.takeaway_fil: Pagkatapos ng baha: itala ang mga alalahanin, iulat ito, at alamin kung aktibo ang lumang roster.
sections.takeaway_en: After flooding: record concerns, relay them, and check whether the old roster is active.

sections.takeaway_fil: Sa mock team change, tukuyin ang dapat kumpirmahin at magbigay ng maikling handover nang walang personal na detalye.
sections.takeaway_en: In a mock team change, identify what to confirm and give a short handover without personal details.

sections.takeaway_fil: Kumpirmahin ang kasalukuyang lider at channel bago mag-handover.
sections.takeaway_en: Confirm the current lead and channel before handing over.

check.prompt_fil: Maaaring nagbago na ang response team. Ano ang una mong gagawin?
check.prompt_en: The response team may have changed. What do you do first?

options.fil: Tawagan ang nakalistang lead sa lumang roster.
options.en: Call the person listed as lead on the old roster.

options.fil: Kumpirmahin ang kasalukuyang lider at channel, saka mag-handover.
options.en: Confirm current lead and channel, then hand over.

options.fil: Ipadala sa lahat ng nasa lumang listahan ang pangalan at sakit ng residente.
options.en: Send the resident's name and illness to everyone on the old list.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Maaaring hindi na siya ang lead; kumpirmahin muna. 2: Kapag kumpirmado ang team at channel, makararating ang pangangailangan sa may pananagutan. 3: Maaaring luma ang listahan, at dapat pribado ang pangalan at detalye ng kalusugan.
check.feedback_en: 1: That person may no longer be the lead; confirm first. 2: A confirmed team and channel mean the need reaches someone responsible. 3: The list may be old, and names and health details must stay private.

sections.takeaway_fil: Huwag ipalagay na aktibo ang BHERT; kumpirmahin ang focal person at gamitin ang tamang channel.
sections.takeaway_en: Do not assume an active BHERT; verify the focal person and use the approved channel.

sections.takeaway_fil: Hindi batayan ng team ngayon ang lumang slide; walang klinikal o enforcement na papel.
sections.takeaway_en: An old slide does not set today's team; no clinical or enforcement duties.

sections.takeaway_fil: Ipasa ang minimum na kailangan, itala ang oras at tiyaking natanggap ito.
sections.takeaway_en: Hand over the minimum needed, record the time and confirm it was received.

check.prompt_fil: Kumpirmado na ang kasalukuyang lead. Ano ang ligtas na susunod na hakbang?
check.prompt_en: You have confirmed the current lead. What is the safe next step?

options.fil: Gamitin ang lumang roster at ipalagay ang dating mandato.
options.en: Use an old roster and assume its former mandate.

options.fil: Iulat ang lugar, pangangailangan at ginawa; itala ang oras.
options.en: Report location, need and action taken; record the time.

options.fil: Mag-handover nang hindi inaalam kung natanggap ito ng team.
options.en: Hand over without checking that the lead or team received it.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Maaaring makapinsala o maantala ang tulong: hindi lumang roster ang batayan ng team ngayon. 2: Sa maikling handover na may oras, masusundan ang pangangailangan. 3: Kung walang pagtanggap, walang nakaaalam kung natanggap ang pangangailangan.
check.feedback_en: 1: This may harm or delay help: an old roster does not set today's team. 2: A short handover with the time recorded keeps the need traceable. 3: Without acknowledgement, no one knows the need was received.

sections.takeaway_fil: Ipa-update at lagyan ng petsa ang role-and-handover card.
sections.takeaway_en: Have the role-and-handover card updated and dated.
